longdesc:
Fencing for VMware virtual machines managed by vCenter using
fence_vmware_rest. This wizard requires a vCenter server with the
VMware REST API; a standalone ESXi host is not supported by this
agent.

Configure one resource for each cluster node. Use the exact, unique
virtual machine name in vCenter inventory and credentials with
permission to query the VM and manage its power state.

The fence-agents-vmware-rest package must be installed on all cluster
nodes. HTTPS is used with certificate verification; the vCenter
certificate must be trusted by the cluster nodes.

SBD remains the recommended fencing mechanism when suitable shared
storage is available.
name: fence-vmware-rest

parameters.longdesc:
Exact, unique VM name in the vCenter inventory, which may differ from
its cluster node name.
parameters.name: machine_name
parameters.shortdesc: Name of machine in vCenter inventory

parameters.longdesc:
IP address or hostname of the vCenter server, without a URL scheme or
path.
parameters.name: server
api_path
parameters.shortdesc: Path of the vCenter REST API
